thread:
Olivia: Postmortem posted for Cust-Riverview Dedicated outage. TL;DR: unstable VPC peering during control-plane deploy + on-prem NAT conntrack exhaustion caused service isolation for a subset of worker nodes. Root cause & action items below.

Raj: Can we get concrete owners and ETAfor each item? Is this a recurring failure class?

Emma: Pattern-check: yes, this matches "peering + NAT" pattern we've seen twice before — spikes during deploy windows expose on-prem conntrack limits.

Marta: Repro summary: simulated 300-600 short-lived TCP flows from client side while forcing a peering route flap. Observed conntrack hits and silent drops. Kernel logs: ```
Dec 02 14:12:03 fw-main kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
Dec 02 14:12:03 fw-main custom-fw: conntrack overflow threshold reached
```

Raj: Proposed owners:
- Raj: peering stability (monitoring + fallback policy)
- Marta: on-prem reproducibility, sizing guidance, runbook updates
- Emma: CS comms & SLA tracking
- Olivia: program-level remediation and exec updates
- Theo: add run automation for peering stress tests

Olivia: Short-term mitigations to apply today:
- enable regional peering fallback flag for Cust-Riverview (rollback-ready) ETA 4h
- push keepalive tuning on gateway (tcp_keepalive_time 15s) ETA 2h
- notify customer with brief status note (Emma) ETA 1h

Marta: Medium/long actions:
- add conntrack-utilization alert (80% threshold) and runbook steps for on-call (ETA 5 days)
- publish NAT pool sizing guideline for Dedicated on-prem installs (ETA 7 days)
- perform BGP hold-time tuning and monitor for false positives (ETA 21 days)
- implement quarterly peering stress test job in CI (Theo owner, ETA 45 days)

DeployBot: Tickets created: INC-52845, REM-52846, CS-52847. Links: https://jira.redwood/INC-52845

Emma: Draft customer message: "We applied temporary network failovers to maintain availability and are coordinating a permanent fix. We'll share a detailed timeline within 10 business days." Please flag if that needs to be stronger.

Raj: Also adding cross-customer task: correlate peering BGP flaps with our control-plane deploys for last 180 days to identify windows of elevated risk. Owner: Raj; ETA 2025-01-10.

Marta: Repro command for runbook (lightweight): ```
for i in $(seq 1 400); do timeout 1 bash -c "</dev/tcp/${PEER_IP}/$((1024 + i % 2000))" & done; sleep 2; dmesg | tail -n 20 | grep conntrack
```

Theo: I'll wire a scheduled workflow to run that harness against a sandpit peering twice weekly; will post the automation PR.

Olivia: Good coverage. Please add any missing items in the Jira tickets. We'll review during the "peering cadence" slot next week. If anything blocks, escalate on #eng-oncall. Closing after cadence notes are attached.

Emma: ack. Adding a line to CS runbook: "Advise customers to size NAT pools for peak concurrent short-lived flows and validate conntrack headroom before Dedicated cutover."

Raj: noted. Also tagging Eng-Platform to consider a control-plane deploy damping window for active peering customers to reduce immediate churn.

Marta: I'll upload detailed lab logs and kernel dumps to REM-52846 this afternoon.
